item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 05:00 AM 29 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are expected over #OrientalMindoro(Pinamalayan, Gloria, Bansud, Bongabong, Roxas, Mansalay, Bulalacao), #Marinduque(Mogpog, Boac, Gasan, Buenavista) and #Romblon within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(PuertoGalera, SanTeodoro, Baco, CityOfCalapan, Naujan, Victoria, Pola and Socorro) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 08:00 AM Today.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 08:00 PM 28 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are expected over #NorthernSamar(Catarman, SanRoque, Mondragon, Pambujan, Laoang, Palapag), #Masbate(CityOfMasbate, Baleno, Monreal, SanJacinto, Mandaon, Aroroy), #Romblon(Romblon, Magdiwang, SanFernando, Cajidiocan, SanAndres, SanAgustin, Calatrava, Concepcion, Banton, Corcuera), #Catanduanes(Viga, Gigmoto, Baras, SanMiguel, Bato), #Marinduque(Mogpog, SantaCruz), #CamarinesSur(Pasacao, Pamplona, SanFernando, Minalabac, Bula, Libmanan, Sipocot, Lupi, Ragay, DelGallego, Siruma, Tinambac, Calabanga, Cabusao), #CamarinesNorte(Paracale, Vinzons, Talisay, Daet, Basud, Mercedes, SanLorenzoRuiz and SanVicente) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro, #Masbate(SanFernando, Batuan, Mobo, Uson, Milagros, Cawayan, Placer, Dimasalang, Palanas, Cataingan, PioV.Corpuz, Esperanza, Balud), #NorthernSamar(SanVicente, Capul, SanAntonio, SanIsidro, Victoria, Allen, Lavezares, Rosario, SanJose, Biri, Bobon), #Sorsogon(Bulan, Matnog, SantaMagdalena, Bulusan, Irosin, Barcelona), #Romblon(Odiongan, Alcantara, Looc, SantaFe, SanJose and SantaMaria) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM Today.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 04:30 PM 28 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Cajidiocan, Magdiwang, SanFernando), #CamarinesNorte(SanVicente, Talisay, Mercedes, Basud, Daet, SanLorenzoRuiz), #CamarinesSur(Ragay, Lupi and Sipocot) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro, #Marinduque, #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Capalonga, JosePanganiban, Labo, Paracale, Vinzons), #CamarinesSur(DelGallego), #Romblon(Alcantara, Banton, Calatrava, Concepcion, Corcuera, Looc, Odiongan, SanAgustin, SanAndres, SanJose, SantaFe, Ferrol, SantaMaria and Romblon) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
